Arjun Mehta: Customer reported an odd billing delta: a streaming toolcall that retried while server-side replay was still finishing ended up with provisional counts on two different sessions. Looks like deferred dedupe failed. Anyone familiar?

Claire Li: can you paste the ledger snippet and note if toolcall ids matched?

Arjun Mehta: trace id tx-2026-06-11-01. toolcall id was the same (tc-2b). ledger: ```
2026-06-11T09:03:01Z TRACE tx-2026-06-11-01 sess=0x10 start toolcall_id=tc-2b provisional=50
2026-06-11T09:03:03Z INFO sess=0x11 retry start toolcall_id=tc-2b provisional=50 (client retried, new session)
2026-06-11T09:03:04Z INFO sess=0x10 resume replayed=30
2026-06-11T09:03:05Z TRACE tx-2026-06-11-01 sess=0x11 confirm toolcall_id=tc-2b confirmed=50
# result: provisional 100 across sessions but confirmed 50
```

billing-bot: ALERT BILL-9843: provisional overlap across sessions for tc-2b detected.

Jordan Park: root cause: we take provisional on start and mark dedupe only when confirm is written on the same session. If confirm arrives on a different session we don't clear the old provisional marker. Our deferred-dedupe background job only looks up confirmed->provisional mappings keyed by session.

Claire Li: fix options: 1) Make provisional claims indexed by (toolcall_id, session) but also maintain a global toolcall index so confirm can atomically clear all matching provisional claims for that toolcall (idempotent). 2) Keep per-session provisional but on confirm emit a reconciliation event that scans for other provisional claims for same toolcall and zeroes them out. Option 2 is lower touch.

Arjun Mehta: prefer option 2 as a short-term patch: on confirm, publish reconcile:event{toolcall_id,confirmed_tokens} to billing-reconciler which will attempt to decrement provisional gauges across sessions when it finds matches. We need to be careful with races: if both sessions confirm (dupe legit), reconciler must not under-credit. Use compare-and-swap on provisional ledger entries.

Jordan Park: agree. Also add a tentatively_reserved flag and a owner_session field to provisional records so reconciler can test owner_session != confirm_session before clearing. Use tombstone with TTL to avoid long-lived claims.

Claire Li: console changes: ops couldn't see provisional ownership; add column in the request timeline for "provisional(owner_session)" and a filter to show outstanding provisionals for an account. Also add an alert rule: provisional_overlap_count > 0 && confirm_count < sum(provisional) -> severity=major.

Arjun Mehta: I'll prototype reconcile:event and the CAS semantics. Jordan, can you add the tombstone TTL change and ensure the reconciler respects dedicated-pool ownership (don't auto-clear provisional for dedicated-customer route without manual review)?

Jordan Park: yes. Also adding metrics: billing.provisional_orphans, billing.reconcile_actions{outcome}. Claire will add dashboard panels.

billing-bot: Acknowledged. Will hold manual reconciliation for affected invoices until patch lands. Ticket BILL-9843 created.

ops-bot: Scheduling canary for reconcile flow on 2% traffic -> 2026-06-12T04:00Z.

Arjun Mehta: GH issue ENG-7001 opened with repro harness and ledger dump. Will post PR when ready. Closing thread but will update on canary results.
